title: Royal Spanish Academy
scope: Complete principal Madrid headquarters exterior: red-brick rectangular main block with pale basement and attic, all four windowed elevations, eleven-bay north frontage with closed secondary door and small balcony, east principal four-column fluted Doric portico with genuinely open intercolumniation, closed entablature and triangular pediment, three closed entry doors and integral descending stairs, low closed slate hip roof with eight brick chimneys, continuous belt courses, dentil cornice and original geometric attic reliefs and pediment figures. Independent garden fence/gates, transient flags, vegetation, street furniture and neighbors remain native. No navigable interior or exact inscription/sculptural likeness is claimed.
axis: +X north, +Z east toward the main portico, -Z west toward the rear, +Y up; approximate 10-degree direction uncertainty.
